active_continuity: The Helper gave Taekyung an unidentified gift and chose to remain in the enduring gray-white space, awaiting an unknown end.
Ma Sanbao and roughly one thousand followers survived Zhuge Feng’s ambush in a remote Henan valley; Baek Yeon and the Son of Heaven confronted him while he was unable to move.
open_questions: What did the Helper give Taekyung?
